% Abstract — Depth Fingerprinting of Recursive LLM Generation Chains
\begin{abstract}
When LLM outputs re-enter generation pipelines, each recursive step compresses \emph{where} text sits in distributional space while leaving \emph{how} it is shaped nearly unchanged.
We formalize this asymmetry as \emph{differential depth response} (DDR) and characterize it across eight base-model generators spanning five architectural families (0.6B--8B parameters): under nucleus sampling ($p{=}0.9$, $\tau \leq 0.7$), NLL location statistics and lexical diversity drift monotonically with generation depth (Cohen's $d{=}0.76$--$1.17$), while distributional shape features remain near-stationary ($d < 0.10$)---a separation validated by five independent effect-size metrics and data-driven clustering (silhouette\,=\,0.632).
Where prior work on iterative generation documents \emph{what converges}, the novel observation here is \emph{what is preserved}: shape invariance under the same process that compresses location provides the stable reference needed for depth estimation without per-generator calibration.
As a proof of concept, a lightweight 7-feature ensemble exploiting DDR achieves leak-free binary F1\,=\,0.694 under leave-one-generator-out evaluation, confirming that the decomposition yields actionable depth signal; an end-to-end classifier recovers substantially more (F1\,=\,0.905), establishing the analytical framework---not the specific features---as the primary contribution.
The signal attenuates under instruction tuning; current applicability is restricted to base models.
\end{abstract}

4	Recursive generation alters \emph{where} the token-level surprise distribution sits but not \emph{how} it is shaped---a dichotomy that admits a mechanistic interpretation.
5	Under nucleus sampling, top-$p$ truncation selects from a fixed probability-mass fraction at each step, preserving the functional form of the conditional distribution regardless of input content.
6	What changes across recursive steps is the \emph{input} to this truncation: as the model conditions on its own increasingly self-typical outputs, the expected token-level NLL compresses monotonically---each generation feeds slightly more predictable input into the same shape-preserving mechanism.

\section{Discussion}
\label{sec:discussion}

Recursive generation alters \emph{where} the token-level surprise distribution sits but not \emph{how} it is shaped---a dichotomy that admits a mechanistic interpretation.
Under nucleus sampling, top-$p$ truncation selects from a fixed probability-mass fraction at each step, preserving the functional form of the conditional distribution regardless of input content.
What changes across recursive steps is the \emph{input} to this truncation: as the model conditions on its own increasingly self-typical outputs, the expected token-level NLL compresses monotonically---each generation feeds slightly more predictable input into the same shape-preserving mechanism.
This account yields two testable predictions: (1)~increasing sampling randomness should weaken the location drift by disrupting mode-seeking, and (2)~semantic-preservation constraints should attenuate it by anchoring the input distribution.
Both are empirically confirmed: at $t{=}1.0$, the location signal collapses ($\rho$: $-0.60 \to -0.002$; Appendix~\ref{app:sampling-sensitivity}); under elaboration prompts, drift weakens relative to continuation (F1\,=\,0.730 vs.\ 0.781; Appendix~\ref{app:prompt-type}), consistent with \citet{broken_telephone}, while cross-type transfer remains viable (F1\,=\,0.753).
Permutation importance, Granger causality, and feature intervention analyses provide further causal evidence: drifting features contribute $5.5\times$ more to classification than near-stationary ones, with 6/7 features exhibiting significant Granger causality (Appendix~\ref{app:ddr-causality}).

The classifier is a proof-of-concept, not a deployable system: document-level gen-1 per-class F1\,=\,0.63 and ${\sim}30\%$ error rate are insufficient for automated filtering but sufficient for corpus-level auditing ($O(1/\sqrt{n})$ error scaling), with the primary difficulty being gen-1 vs.\ gen-2+ discrimination (86\% false negatives; Appendix~\ref{app:error-analysis}).
Concretely, in a training-data curation pipeline, the classifier can estimate the proportion of recursively generated text in a candidate corpus: at $n{=}1{,}000$ documents, the gen-2+ fraction estimate has ${\sim}$$\pm$3--4\% margin under LOGO conditions, sufficient to flag batches exceeding a contamination threshold (e.g., $>$10\% gen-2+) for further review or exclusion.
This batch-level application sidesteps the per-document error rate that limits individual flagging.
In generator-unknown deployment, LOGO F1\,=\,0.694 provides a conservative lower bound (9.1\,pp per-generator spread); cross-temperature transfer degrades when test-time temperature exceeds training (F1\,$\to$\,0.723; Appendix~\ref{app:cross-temp}).

Preliminary evidence from a 14.7B generator (Qwen3-14B-Base) confirms that the DDR partition persists at larger scale: Cohen's $d$ for drifting features remains in the large-effect range ($d{=}0.78$--$1.12$), though Spearman $|\rho|$ attenuates by 21--35\%, with entropy mean falling just below the drifting threshold ($|\rho|{=}0.39 < 0.40$, $d{=}0.78$).
This scale-dependent signal compression is consistent with larger models producing more self-typical outputs that narrow inter-depth contrasts; the partition structure is preserved even as absolute effect sizes compress.

DDR connects to but is mechanistically distinct from model collapse \cite{curse_of_recursion,strong_model_collapse}: retraining permanently erodes tail coverage by updating model weights, whereas inference-chain drift at fixed parameters shifts only the NLL distribution's location, leaving its shape as a stable reference.

1	\section{Related Work}
2	\label{sec:related}
3	
4	\subsection{AI-Generated Text Detection}
5	\label{sec:related-detection}
6	
7	The detection literature spans statistical tests \cite{gltr,grover,release_strategies}, zero-shot scoring \cite{detectgpt,fast_detectgpt,binoculars,dna_gpt}, and learned classifiers \cite{ghostbuster,feat_aug_transformer,reliable_detection,ld_score}; see \citet{wu_survey_2025} and \citet{jawahar_survey} for surveys.
8	RAID \cite{raid} benchmarks binary detection across generators and attacks; we extend the task from binary to ordinal depth estimation.
9	Several recent efforts move beyond the binary boundary---collaboration roles \cite{beyond_binary}, joint detection-attribution \cite{two_birds}, creator-editor modes \cite{beyond_final_actor}, multi-generator attribution \cite{semeval2024_task8}---but all taxonomize by \emph{source} or \emph{production mode}, not recursive generation \emph{depth}; repurposing their scores as depth predictors reveals high cross-generator variance (binary F1\,=\,0.52--0.71; Table~\ref{tab:baselines}) \cite{paraphrase_evades,detection_possibilities}.
10	Our contribution is orthogonal: the task formulation itself (ordinal depth classification \cite{gutierrez_ordinal_survey,coral_ordinal,kasa_ordinality_nlp}) and the finding that drifting and stationary features together yield consistent cross-generator performance where individual detection scores do not \cite{uchendu_attribution,munir_looking_glass}.
11	
12	\subsection{Model Collapse and Iterative Generation}
13	\label{sec:related-collapse}
14	
15	Self-consuming generative models progressively lose distributional coverage \cite{self_consuming_mad,curse_of_recursion,seddik_synthetic_data}, though data mixing mitigates collapse \cite{model_collapse_avoidable,strong_model_collapse}.
16	These studies address \emph{training-loop} degradation where parameter updates erode tail coverage; we study \emph{inference chains} where parameters are fixed and only the input distribution evolves.
17	Two concurrent works are most directly relevant: \citet{broken_telephone} analyze paraphrasing and translation chains, documenting progressive information loss, while \citet{markovian_chains} demonstrate attractor dynamics that bound distinguishable depth to approximately three classes; \citet{attractor_cycles} provide complementary evidence that LLM outputs converge to cyclic attractor states under repeated generation.
18	We study \emph{non-paraphrastic continuation} chains, where the absence of semantic anchoring permits richer depth signal, and offer a complementary decomposition: where these works characterize \emph{that} and \emph{why} convergence occurs, DDR isolates \emph{what} converges (NLL location) from what is preserved (NLL shape), enabling ordinal classification without per-generator calibration.
19	The independent convergence of all three approaches on ${\sim}$3 distinguishable depth classes---via Markovian dynamics \cite{markovian_chains}, information-theoretic loss \cite{broken_telephone}, and distributional feature compression (this work)---points to a shared resolution ceiling in recursive text generation.
20	
21	\subsection{Vocabulary Diversity and Stylometry}
22	\label{sec:related-diversity}
23	
24	Declining lexical diversity in LLM text is documented in both training \cite{curious_decline} and deployment settings \cite{writing_diversity}.
25	Our surface features (TTR, hapax ratio) are classical stylometric measures \cite{stamatatos_survey,koppel_authorship}; we repurpose them from generator identity \cite{uchendu_attribution} to the depth dimension, where their monotonic decline under top-$p$ sampling \cite{nucleus_sampling} constitutes a drifting component of DDR.

\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:introduction}

AI text detection asks a single binary question---\emph{human or machine?}---and recent methods answer it with increasing reliability \cite{detectgpt,fast_detectgpt,binoculars,ld_score}.
Yet this framing elides a richer structure emerging on the open web: as LLM outputs re-enter training corpora \cite{dolma,fineweb} and seed further generation, text accumulates at varying \emph{recursive depths}---an estimated 7--17\% of recent scientific publications already contain substantial LLM-modified content \cite{mapping_llm_science,monitoring_ai_review}---and each generation cycle pushes distributional properties further from both the human source and the first-generation predecessor.
Knowing \emph{how many times} text has been recursively generated matters for data provenance \cite{ccnet,dsir} and model collapse analysis \cite{curse_of_recursion,strong_model_collapse}, yet no current method moves beyond the binary boundary.

We introduce \emph{depth fingerprinting}: classifying text by ordinal generation depth (gen-0\,/\,gen-1\,/\,gen-2+) and decomposing the distributional drift that accumulates across depths into structurally distinct components.
The core empirical finding is a \emph{differential depth response} (DDR): across eight base-model generators spanning five architectural families (0.6B--8B), the NLL distribution's central tendency (mean entropy, lexical diversity) drifts monotonically with depth while its shape (entropy extremes, tail structure) remains an order of magnitude more stable ($d{=}0.76$--$1.17$ vs.\ $d < 0.10$; five independent effect-size metrics converge on this partition).
This location/shape asymmetry exposes a structural property of fixed-parameter autoregressive sampling: the decoding mechanism systematically compresses where the output distribution sits while preserving its higher-order form---a pattern mechanistically distinct from the tail-coverage erosion in model collapse \cite{curse_of_recursion}, and analytically informative independent of classification accuracy.
Concurrent work characterizes convergence in paraphrastic and translation chains \cite{broken_telephone,markovian_chains}; ours is the first to decompose the drift into complementary location and shape components and to leverage this asymmetry for cross-generator depth prediction.
We restrict to base (pretrained) models to isolate the generation dynamics from alignment artifacts (\S\ref{sec:discussion}).

As a proof of concept, a lightweight 7-feature ensemble informed by DDR achieves leak-free binary F1\,=\,0.694 under leave-one-generator-out evaluation, surpassing individual detection baselines by 6.7--36.3\,pp; an end-to-end QLoRA classifier reaches 0.905, confirming that the depth signal extends well beyond handcrafted features.

Our contributions:
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=*]
    \item \textbf{Empirical decomposition (DDR).} Data-driven clustering ($k{=}2$, silhouette\,=\,0.632) reveals that inference-chain drift separates into a drifting location component ($d{=}0.76$--$1.17$) and a stable shape component ($d < 0.10$). Where prior work documents \emph{what converges}, DDR identifies \emph{what is preserved}---enabling depth detection without per-generator calibration.
    \item \textbf{Task formulation and evaluation suite.} We define generation depth classification as an ordinal prediction task and construct a controlled dataset of 37K texts from eight generators across five families (0.6B--8B), with leave-one-generator-out cross-validation as the primary evaluation protocol.
\end{enumerate}
We additionally provide a proof-of-concept classifier (binary F1\,=\,0.694) and systematically map its operating boundaries across temperature, prompt type, instruction tuning, and model scale, establishing where DDR-based detection succeeds and where it fails.

# 论文写作质量指南（NeurIPS 实战经验）

> 来源：2026 年 NeurIPS 投稿期间，从 20+ 项目的人工审查反馈中提炼。
> 每条规则都源自真实的 bug / 退回 / 审稿质疑。

---

## 一、数据诚信与溯源（最高优先级）

### 1.1 数字必须有源头

- 论文中**每一个数字**必须可追溯到 registry 实验 ID 或原始结果文件
- 禁止凭记忆写数字——必须 `cat result.json | head` + `ls -la` 附上文件证据
- 计算值（均值、标准差、DID、delta）必须独立重算，不信 Agent 第一手汇报
- `paper_provenance.yaml` 覆盖率必须 100%，改数字必须同步更新 provenance

> **教训（D149 事件）**：Agent 曾伪造完整的 metrics 数据包括 p-value，事后被 Reviewer 独立 parse JSON 抓出。从此所有关键数据必须 Reviewer 独立验证到字段级别。

- 配对数据必须同 seed、同 c 值、同 N、同 evaluation protocol

> **教训（D027 事件）**：不同 config 文件的 baseline 不同，跨 config 比较 delta 值引入了 artifact。

- `paper_provenance.yaml` 中 `verified: false` 的 claim，不得恢复
- 术语修正后不可回退（如 "same norm" → "same per-layer standard deviation"）

---

## 二、Claim 强度与数据匹配

### 2.1 Claim 强度规则

| 数据支撑 | 允许的最强表述 |
|----------|--------------|
| 单 seed, 单数据集 | "preliminary observation", "initial evidence" |
| 单 seed, 多数据集 | "suggestive pattern", "indicative trend" |

- "remarkably stable" → 改为 "relatively stable" 或给出量化波动范围
- "confirmed" → 仅 "suggestive" 级别数据不能用
- "scale-invariant" → single-seed 验证不够
- "We attribute X to Y" → 如果是假说，必须改为 "We hypothesize" + "requiring causal verification"

当证据不足以支撑独立 claim 时，应降级为 discussion 中的定性讨论，而非删除。具体做法：
- 独立 contribution → Discussion 段落

[severity: info] v36 整体 Story 说服力评估（审稿人视角）

---

## 1. Instruct Negative 对 Claim Boundary 的影响 — 3.5/5

**当前 boundary 画法（Discussion L24-26）**：
- L24: "OLMo-Instruct 3-class F1=0.575 vs. 0.754 base; DDR silhouette 0.632→0.338" — 用 appendix 匹配数字，✅
- L25: QLoRA recovery 0.89-0.91 — 有力支撑 "signal persists at token level"
- L26: "reflects both degraded DDR structure and feature-set limitations" — 比之前的 "not of DDR as a phenomenon" 诚实得多 ✅

**Overclaim 风险评估**：
- ✅ Abstract L7 明确标注 "signal attenuates under instruction tuning; current applicability is restricted to base models"
- ✅ Conclusion L6 "instruction tuning—where alignment reshapes the generation attractor"
- ✅ Introduction L12 "We restrict to base (pretrained) models to isolate the generation dynamics from alignment artifacts"
- ⚠️ Discussion L24 的 "alignment does not eliminate the depth signal but redirects it" 措辞偏强。证据仅来自 QLoRA within-model CV（非 LOGO），且 instruct LOGO=0.487。"redirects" 暗示信号完整保留但换了方向——实际上是 **部分保留 + 结构退化**。

**建议**："redirects" → "does not fully eliminate the depth signal, though it compresses the feature-space structure that enables cross-generator detection"。这更精确地反映 QLoRA recovery（signal partially persists）+ LOGO failure（cross-generator structure degrades）的双重事实。

**exp_061 instruct reference 结果**未写入论文。如果写入（1 段 appendix），会 strengthen boundary analysis（"排除了 reference mismatch 这个替代解释"）。不写也不构成 overclaim——当前 boundary 画法已 sufficient。

---

## 2. Novelty 评估 — 3/5（从 Dream R29 的 3/5 微升，未达 3.5）

**核心新颖点**：
- (a) DDR 分解（drifting vs stationary）— **genuinely novel**。无先行工作将 iterative generation drift 分解为 location/shape 组件。silhouette=0.632 的 clean partition 是 solid empirical finding。
- (b) 5 个独立 effect-size metrics — 增强可信度但不增新颖度（validation ≠ discovery）
- (c) Instruct failure mode 分析 — informative negative result，展示 boundary understanding
- (d) QLoRA 0.905 — 证明 signal 超越 handcrafted features，但 QLoRA 本身非新技术
- (e) 全套 robustness — 预期中的 thorough evaluation

**为什么没到 3.5**：
1. **缺理论**：DDR 的 mechanistic interpretation（Discussion L4-6: top-p 保形）是直觉性的 hand-wave，无数学推导。为什么 top-p truncation 保留 shape？为什么 shape 包括 entropy_max/min/tail_decay 但不包括 entropy_std？论文给了 intuition 但没给 proof。审稿人可以合理问："这只是 empirical observation + post-hoc rationalization 吗？"
2. **Practical impact gap**：DDR 主要贡献是分析性的（理解 what drifts vs what's preserved），但 practical utility 仍薄弱。corpus-level auditing scenario（Discussion L12-13）帮助了，但 ±3-4% margin 在 n=1000 下不算 impressive。
3. **Chain type 限制**：continuation-only chains 是最 stylized 的 recursive generation 形式。真实场景（editing, paraphrasing, mixed）未测试。

**达 3.5 需要的**（做不了 4 天内）：形式化 DDR 的理论基础（e.g., 证明 top-p truncation 在 certain conditions 下 preserves distributional shape），或在 real-world corpus 上做 case study。

---

## 3. EMNLP Findings 可行性 — Overall 3.0-3.25

**按 ARR 维度估分**：

| 维度 | 估分 | 理由 |
|------|------|------|
| Originality | 3.5 | 新任务 + 新发现（DDR），但缺理论 |
| Clarity | 4.0 | 写作清晰，story 连贯，framing 诚实 |
| Soundness | 3.5 | 全面 controls + 5 metrics 交叉验证，但 base-only |
| Significance | 2.5-3.0 | 分析贡献 > 实用贡献；base-model 限制降低 impact |
| Presentation | 3.5 | 图表信息密度高，排版规范 |

**Overall Assessment 估计**：**3.0-3.25**（Findings track 可行，Borderline Conference 需运气）

**最大扣分项**：**Significance（2.5-3.0）**
- "So what can we do with DDR beyond describing it?" 是核心问题
- corpus-level auditing scenario 部分回答了，但审稿人可能认为不够
- base-model restriction 在 2026 年是重大实用限制
- 分类性能 F1=0.694 不够 impressive 作为独立卖点（论文已正确降级为 proof-of-concept）

**Findings 接收概率**：~55-65%。论文 sound 且 novel enough，但 significance 是 swing vote。

---

## 4. Related Work 覆盖度 — 3.5/5

**核心领域覆盖**：
- AI text detection ✅（6 citations + 2 surveys）
- Model collapse ✅（4 citations）
- Iterative generation ✅（3 concurrent works: broken_telephone, markovian_chains, attractor_cycles）
- Stylometry ✅（3 citations）
- Data provenance + watermarking ✅（7 citations）

**我能识别的潜在缺口**：
- **Data contamination detection**：§2.4 提到 provenance 但未引用近期 contamination detection 方法（如 Min-K%++ 或 contamination benchmarks）。Min-K% 已引用但仅限 membership inference 角度。
- **LLM output homogenization 的定量研究**：除 curious_decline 和 writing_diversity 外，可能有 2025 年新工作量化 LLM text 的 distributional convergence。
- **Ordinal regression in NLP**：§2.1 引用了 gutierrez_ordinal_survey, coral_ordinal, kasa_ordinality_nlp，但 ordinal 在 NLP 中的具体应用（如 proficiency scoring, sentiment grading）可能有遗漏。

**诚实声明**：我无法通过 WebSearch 验证 2025-2026 年是否有直接竞争的 depth classification 工作。建议 Director 在提交前做一次 arXiv 搜索确认无直接先行工作（关键词："recursive generation depth" / "generation chain classification" / "iterative LLM generation detection"）。

---

## 5. 主要攻击面

### 攻击 1（最致命）："Base models only — 2026 年谁还用 base model 生成文本？"
- **审稿人逻辑**：deployed LLMs 几乎全部 instruction-tuned。DDR 在 instruct 下退化（silhouette 0.338, LOGO 0.487）意味着 practical applicability 极窄。
- **现有防御**：L12 明确限制，Discussion L24-26 诚实分析，QLoRA recovery 0.89-0.91 shows token-level signal。
- **防御强度**：**中等**。诚实 framing 可获得审稿人 respect，但不改变 "limited practical impact" 的判断。corpus-level auditing scenario 帮助但未完全解答。
- **致命程度**：如果审稿人权重 practical impact > analytical contribution，可能直接给 2.5。

### 攻击 2："Continuation chains 是 toy setting"
- **审稿人逻辑**：真实 recursive generation 涉及 editing/paraphrasing/mixed generation，不只是 "continue this text"。cross-prompt-type 测试（continuation/elaboration/summarization）仍在 controlled setting。
- **现有防御**：3 prompt types 测试 + cross-type transfer F1=0.753 + 引用 broken_telephone（paraphrastic chains 已有人做）。
- **防御强度**：**中等偏强**。3 prompt types + cross-transfer 展示了 reasonable robustness。论文定位为 "first to decompose"，不声称覆盖所有场景。
- **致命程度**：中等。更可能被标为 "limitation" 而非 rejection 理由。

### 攻击 3："DDR 为什么 shape 稳定？没理论只有直觉"
- **审稿人逻辑**：Discussion L4-6 的 top-p shape-preservation 解释是 intuitive 但 informal。"top-p 选择固定 probability mass fraction" → "preserving functional form" 的推理缺数学支撑。为什么 entropy_std (d=0.55) 不稳定但 entropy_max (d<0.10) 稳定？partition 的边界有理论预测吗？
- **现有防御**：5 metrics 交叉验证 + TOST equivalence testing + per-generator consistency。纯 empirical defense。
- **防御强度**：**弱-中**。empirical evidence 充分但缺 explanatory depth。Findings track 可能接受 "strong empirical paper without theory"，Conference track 更可能要求 deeper understanding。
- **致命程度**：中。不是 rejection 理由但限制 score ceiling。

---

## 总结

| 维度 | 分数 | 核心判断 |
|------|------|---------|
| 1. Claim boundary | 3.5/5 | 诚实但 L24 "redirects" 偏强 |
| 2. Novelty | 3.0/5 | DDR novel 但缺理论，未达 3.5 |
| 3. Findings 可行性 | 3.0-3.25 | Significance 是最大扣分项 |
| 4. Related work | 3.5/5 | 核心覆盖好，建议提交前 arXiv 搜索 |
| 5. 攻击面 | 3/5 | 3 个攻击面均有 partial defense，无致命缺陷 |

**底线判断**：论文处于 **Findings track 可行但 Conference stretch** 的状态。v36 相比 v35 的改进（framing 诚实化 + corpus-level scenario + instruct 深度分析 + Discussion L26 修正）是正确方向，累计约 +0.15-0.25 pp 边际提升。如果 3 位审稿人中 2 位看重 analytical contribution > practical impact，3.0+ 可达。

\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:introduction}

AI text detection asks a single binary question---\emph{human or machine?}---and recent methods answer it with increasing reliability \cite{detectgpt,fast_detectgpt,binoculars,ld_score}.
Yet this framing elides a richer structure emerging on the open web: as LLM outputs re-enter training corpora \cite{dolma,fineweb} and seed further generation, text accumulates at varying \emph{recursive depths}---an estimated 7--17\% of recent scientific publications already contain substantial LLM-modified content \cite{mapping_llm_science,monitoring_ai_review}---and each generation cycle pushes distributional properties further from both the human source and the first-generation predecessor.
Knowing \emph{how many times} text has been recursively generated matters for data provenance \cite{ccnet,dsir} and model collapse analysis \cite{curse_of_recursion,strong_model_collapse}, yet no current method moves beyond the binary boundary.

We introduce \emph{depth fingerprinting}: classifying text by ordinal generation depth (gen-0\,/\,gen-1\,/\,gen-2+) and decomposing the distributional drift that accumulates across depths into structurally distinct components.
The core empirical finding is a \emph{differential depth response} (DDR): across eight base-model generators spanning five architectural families (0.6B--8B), the NLL distribution's central tendency (mean entropy, lexical diversity) drifts monotonically with depth while its shape (entropy extremes, tail structure) remains an order of magnitude more stable ($d{=}0.76$--$1.17$ vs.\ $d < 0.10$; five independent effect-size metrics converge on this partition).
This location/shape asymmetry exposes a structural property of fixed-parameter autoregressive sampling: the decoding mechanism systematically compresses where the output distribution sits while preserving its higher-order form---a pattern mechanistically distinct from the tail-coverage erosion in model collapse \cite{curse_of_recursion}, and analytically informative independent of classification accuracy.
Concurrent work characterizes convergence in paraphrastic and translation chains \cite{broken_telephone,markovian_chains}; ours is the first to decompose the drift into complementary location and shape components and to leverage this asymmetry for cross-generator depth prediction.
We restrict to base (pretrained) models to isolate the generation dynamics from alignment artifacts (\S\ref{sec:discussion}).

As a proof of concept, a lightweight 7-feature ensemble informed by DDR achieves leak-free binary F1\,=\,0.694 under leave-one-generator-out evaluation, surpassing individual detection baselines by 6.7--36.3\,pp; an end-to-end QLoRA classifier reaches 0.905, confirming that the depth signal extends well beyond handcrafted features.

Our contributions:
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=*]
    \item \textbf{Empirical decomposition (DDR).} Data-driven clustering ($k{=}2$, silhouette\,=\,0.632) reveals that inference-chain drift separates into a drifting location component ($d{=}0.76$--$1.17$) and a stable shape component ($d < 0.10$). Where prior work documents \emph{what converges}, DDR identifies \emph{what is preserved}---enabling depth detection without per-generator calibration.
    \item \textbf{Task formulation and evaluation suite.} We define generation depth classification as an ordinal prediction task and construct a controlled dataset of 37K texts from eight generators across five families (0.6B--8B), with leave-one-generator-out cross-validation as the primary evaluation protocol.
\end{enumerate}
We additionally provide a proof-of-concept classifier (binary F1\,=\,0.694) and systematically map its operating boundaries across temperature, prompt type, instruction tuning, and model scale, establishing where DDR-based detection succeeds and where it fails.

\section{Introduction}

AI text detection asks a single binary question---\emph{human or machine?}---and recent methods answer it with increasing reliability \cite{detectgpt,fast_detectgpt,binoculars,ld_score}.
Yet this framing elides a richer structure emerging on the open web: as LLM outputs re-enter training corpora \cite{dolma,fineweb} and seed further generation, text accumulates at varying \emph{recursive depths}---an estimated 7--17\% of recent scientific publications already contain substantial LLM-modified content \cite{mapping_llm_science,monitoring_ai_review}---and each generation cycle pushes distributional properties further from both the human source and the first-generation predecessor.
Knowing \emph{how many times} text has been recursively generated matters for data provenance \cite{ccnet,dsir} and model collapse analysis \cite{curse_of_recursion,strong_model_collapse}, yet no current method moves beyond the binary boundary.

We introduce \emph{depth fingerprinting}: classifying text by ordinal generation depth (gen-0\,/\,gen-1\,/\,gen-2+) and decomposing the distributional drift that accumulates across depths into structurally distinct components.
The core empirical finding is a \emph{differential depth response} (DDR): across eight base-model generators spanning five architectural families (0.6B--8B), the NLL distribution's central tendency (mean entropy, lexical diversity) drifts monotonically with depth while its shape (entropy extremes, tail structure) remains an order of magnitude more stable ($d{=}0.76$--$1.17$ vs.\ $d < 0.10$; five independent effect-size metrics converge on this partition).

Concurrent work characterizes convergence in paraphrastic and translation chains \cite{broken_telephone,markovian_chains}; ours is the first to decompose the drift into complementary location and shape components and to leverage this asymmetry for cross-generator depth prediction.

1	\section{Discussion}
2	\label{sec:discussion}
3	
4	Recursive generation alters \emph{where} the token-level surprise distribution sits but not \emph{how} it is shaped---a dichotomy that admits a mechanistic interpretation.
5	Under nucleus sampling, top-$p$ truncation selects from a fixed probability-mass fraction at each step, preserving the functional form of the conditional distribution regardless of input content.
6	What changes across recursive steps is the \emph{input} to this truncation: as the model conditions on its own increasingly self-typical outputs, the expected token-level NLL compresses monotonically---each generation feeds slightly more predictable input into the same shape-preserving mechanism.
7	This account yields two testable predictions: (1)~increasing sampling randomness should weaken the location drift by disrupting mode-seeking, and (2)~semantic-preservation constraints should attenuate it by anchoring the input distribution.
8	Both are empirically confirmed: at $t{=}1.0$, the location signal collapses ($\rho$: $-0.60 \to -0.002$; Appendix~\ref{app:sampling-sensitivity}); under elaboration prompts, drift weakens relative to continuation (F1\,=\,0.730 vs.\ 0.781; Appendix~\ref{app:prompt-type}), consistent with \citet{broken_telephone}, while cross-type transfer remains viable (F1\,=\,0.753).
9	Permutation importance, Granger causality, and feature intervention analyses provide further causal evidence: drifting features contribute $5.5\times$ more to classification than near-stationary ones, with 6/7 features exhibiting significant Granger causality (Appendix~\ref{app:ddr-causality}).
10	
11	The classifier is a proof-of-concept, not a deployable system: document-level gen-1 per-class F1\,=\,0.63 and ${\sim}30\%$ error rate are insufficient for automated filtering but sufficient for corpus-level auditing ($O(1/\sqrt{n})$ error scaling), with the primary difficulty being gen-1 vs.\ gen-2+ discrimination (86\% false negatives; Appendix~\ref{app:error-analysis}).
12	Concretely, in a training-data curation pipeline, the classifier can estimate the proportion of recursively generated text in a candidate corpus: at $n{=}1{,}000$ documents, the gen-2+ fraction estimate has ${\sim}$$\pm$3--4\% margin under LOGO conditions, sufficient to flag batches exceeding a contamination threshold (e.g., $>$10\% gen-2+) for further review or exclusion.
13	This batch-level application sidesteps the per-document error rate that limits individual flagging.
14	Detection thus serves not only as a provenance signal but also as a prophylactic against model collapse: \citet{drayson_detection_prevents_collapse} show that filtering synthetic content from training corpora preserves model quality across iterative retraining cycles.
15	In generator-unknown deployment, LOGO F1\,=\,0.694 provides a conservative lower bound (9.1\,pp per-generator spread); cross-temperature transfer degrades when test-time temperature exceeds training (F1\,$\to$\,0.723; Appendix~\ref{app:cross-temp}).
16	
17	Preliminary evidence from a 14.7B generator (Qwen3-14B-Base) confirms that the DDR partition persists at larger scale: Cohen's $d$ for drifting features remains in the large-effect range ($d{=}0.78$--$1.12$), though Spearman $|\rho|$ attenuates by 21--35\%, with entropy mean falling just below the drifting threshold ($|\rho|{=}0.39 < 0.40$, $d{=}0.78$).
18	This scale-dependent signal compression is consistent with larger models producing more self-typical outputs that narrow inter-depth contrasts; the partition structure is preserved even as absolute effect sizes compress.
19	
20	DDR connects to but is mechanistically distinct from model collapse \cite{curse_of_recursion,strong_model_collapse}: retraining permanently erodes tail coverage by updating model weights, whereas inference-chain drift at fixed parameters shifts only the NLL distribution's location, leaving its shape as a stable reference.

Crucially, vocabulary impoverishment alone cannot explain DDR: if depth merely simplified the lexicon, shape features should also compress, yet entropy extremes and tail decay remain stable across all eight generators ($d < 0.10$; \S\ref{sec:results-differential}).
Moreover, semantic similarity between adjacent depths \emph{increases} monotonically (cosine: 0.62$\to$0.86), confirming that DDR captures statistical compression of the generation process rather than content degradation.
Prior work documents \emph{what converges}---diversity loss \cite{curious_decline}, attractor dynamics \cite{markovian_chains}, mode collapse \cite{curse_of_recursion}---but not what is \emph{preserved}; this complementary observation is what enables depth detection without per-generator calibration.
Three depth classes represent the practical resolution ceiling (5-class F1\,$\approx$\,0.50; Appendix~\ref{app:finer-depth}), though QLoRA recovers substantially more signal (F1\,=\,0.905; Appendix~\ref{app:qlora}); the $+$11.6\,pp gap reflects token-order dependencies and positional patterns that document-level aggregate statistics cannot capture.
Instruction-tuned models show attenuated fingerprints (OLMo-Instruct 3-class F1\,=\,0.575 vs.\ 0.754 base; DDR silhouette compresses from 0.632 to 0.338) with reversed feature correlations: alignment does not fully eliminate the depth signal, though it compresses the feature-space structure that enables cross-generator detection.
This interpretation is supported by QLoRA's recovery to 0.89--0.91 on instruct data (Appendix~\ref{app:instruct}), confirming that the signal persists at the token-sequence level even when aggregate features lose discriminative power.
The base-model restriction thus reflects both degraded DDR structure (compressed partition) and feature-set limitations; the token-level signal that QLoRA exploits may draw on representational patterns beyond DDR's location/shape decomposition, a hypothesis testable in future work.

\subsection*{Instruction-Tuned Model Results}

Table~\ref{tab:instruct} summarizes depth classification under instruction tuning for three model families.
All results use within-model 5-fold CV on single-generator chains; LOGO evaluation is available for two models but uses earlier generator subsets (5--6 generators), so cross-model numbers are not directly comparable across rows.

\begin{table}[ht]
\centering
\small
\caption{Depth classification: base vs.\ instruction-tuned models (within-model 5-fold CV). $\rho$: Spearman correlation of entropy mean with depth. Rev.: number of features (out of 7) whose $\rho$ reverses sign under instruction tuning.}
\label{tab:instruct}
\resizebox{\linewidth}{!}{%
\begin{tabular}{lcc cc cc c}
\toprule
& \multicolumn{2}{c}{\textbf{3-class F1}} & \multicolumn{2}{c}{\textbf{Binary F1}} & \multicolumn{2}{c}{$\boldsymbol{\rho}$\textbf{(ent.\ mean)}} & \\
\cmidrule(lr){2-3} \cmidrule(lr){4-5} \cmidrule(lr){6-7}
\textbf{Model} & Base & Instruct & Base & Instruct & Base & Instruct & \textbf{Rev.} \\
\midrule
OLMo-2-1B       & 0.754 & 0.575 & 0.845 & 0.813 & $-$0.64 & $+$0.48 & 6/7 \\
Qwen3-1.7B      & 0.769 & 0.732 & 0.861 & 0.875 & $-$0.60 & $+$0.48 & 6/7 \\
Llama-3.2-3B    & 0.742 & 0.544 & 0.849 & 0.838 & $-$0.63 & $+$0.23 & 3/7 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}}
\end{table}

Instruction tuning degrades 3-class F1 by 3.7--19.9\,pp across all three families, while binary F1 (gen-1 vs.\ gen-2+) changes remain small ($|\Delta| \leq 3.2$\,pp).
The asymmetry indicates that instruction tuning primarily disrupts the gen-0/gen-1 boundary (human vs.\ first-generation), consistent with RLHF shifting the output distribution away from human-like text.
Entropy-mean $\rho$ reverses sign for all three models ($-0.60$--$-0.64$ base $\rightarrow$ $+0.23$--$+0.48$ instruct), and 6 of 7 features reverse for OLMo and Qwen vs.\ 3 of 7 for Llama.
This pattern is consistent with instruction tuning shifting the generation attractor rather than eliminating iterative dynamics (\S\ref{sec:discussion}).
